whyExists.title: The Future of Healthy, Regenerative Organizations
whyExists.description:
COIREA replaces fragmented management tools with one integrated system for execution clarity.

It measures organizational health across five pillars, detects misalignment before it becomes costly, and translates data into clear ownership and strategic focus.

Its trained Organizational AI works within your system (not on generic benchmarks) ensuring growth builds capacity instead of draining it.

pillars.title: What COIREA Measures
pillars.subtitle: The 5 Pillars of Organizational Intelligence

purpose.title: Vision
purpose.subtitle: Clarity and Direction
purpose.description: Defines why the organization exists and how it behaves. Anchors decisions in shared direction, reducing drift and internal friction.

leadership.title: Leadership
leadership.subtitle: Ownership and Accountability
leadership.description: Structures clear roles, decision rights, and responsibility. Prevents bottlenecks and distributes authority with clarity.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.subtitle: Trust and Coordination
collaboration.description: Creates systems that reduce silos and increase collective intelligence. Aligns communication, feedback, and team agreements with execution needs.
collaboration.drives: Better decisions, stronger teamwork, efficient delivery.

wellbeing.title: Well-Being
wellbeing.subtitle: Energy and Sustainability
wellbeing.description: Treats human energy as a strategic asset. Monitors capacity, burnout signals, and resilience in real time.

strategy.title: Strategy & Execution
strategy.subtitle: Structure and Momentum
strategy.description: Connects long-term vision to quarterly priorities and ownership. Prevents strategic drift and ensures progress is measurable.

pillars.footer: All captured in real time. All in one system.

dashboard.title: System-Level Clarity in One Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: The Evolution Dashboard
dashboard.description: Turn organizational signals into goal-aligned execution.
dashboard.description2: COIREA centralizes signals across vision, culture, leadership, collaboration, well-being, and strategy, and uses trained Organizational AI to interpret how these dimensions impact your goals.
dashboard.result: The result: faster correction, clearer priorities, and growth that builds systemic capacity instead of exhausting it.

aiAgent.title: Meet GiA: COIREA's Trained Organizational AI
aiAgent.subtitle: Your System Intelligence Layer
aiAgent.description: GiA is not a generic chatbot or external analytics engine. It is a trained Organizational AI designed specifically to interpret patterns within your organization's own data — across governance, culture, execution, collaboration, and well-being.
aiAgent.description2: Instead of generating answers from external models, GiA learns from your system's internal signals. It identifies structural tensions, recurring behavioral patterns, and early indicators of misalignment — converting them into clear, contextual guidance.
aiAgent.closingNote1: The intelligence stays inside your field.
aiAgent.closingNote2: The insights are specific to your organization.

nodes.title: What GiA Makes Visible
nodes.subtitle: Six system-level questions GiA continuously interprets from your organizational data.

directionCoherence.title: Direction Coherence
directionCoherence.question: Is our daily work moving in the direction we say matters most?
directionCoherence.clarification: Are projects and initiatives aligned with the strategy and vision?

systemCapacity.title: System Capacity
systemCapacity.question: Does our system have the energy and space to deliver what we have committed to?
systemCapacity.clarification: Do people and teams have the capacity for current projects?

roleClarity.title: Role Clarity
roleClarity.question: Are responsibilities held in ways that allow people to contribute at their best?
roleClarity.clarification: Are roles clear, balanced, and properly owned?

projectContribution.title: Project Contribution
projectContribution.question: How are our current initiatives strengthening the evolution of the organization?
projectContribution.clarification: Which projects strengthen the system and which create friction?

systemTensions.title: System Tensions
systemTensions.question: Where is the system asking for attention or adaptation?

nextEvolution.title: Next Evolution
nextEvolution.question: What small structural changes could restore greater coherence?
nextEvolution.clarification: What actions should leadership consider next?
